children: Pandey was responsible for financial planning, reporting and compliance at the automaker's India operations
Gautam Pandey has stepped down as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Stellantis India, people familiar with the development told Autocar Professional.

Pandey headed the finance function at Stellantis India, with responsibility for financial planning, reporting and compliance. His reason for leaving and his next assignment could not be immediately ascertained.
Before joining Stellantis India, Pandey worked with Nissan, Ford and Tata Power. He is an alumnus of the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade, Delhi.

Stellantis India is led by Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Shailesh Hazela. The company reorganised some of its senior leadership responsibilities in May 2025 as it prepared for the addition of the Leapmotor electric vehicle brand and continued operations under the Jeep and Citroën brands.
Stellantis currently sells vehicles in India under the Jeep and Citroën brands and has announced plans to introduce Leapmotor vehicles in the country.

The automaker has been working to increase capacity utilisation at its Indian manufacturing plants through a combination of domestic sales and exports. Citroën vehicles manufactured in India are exported to markets including South Africa.
The company also operates Stellantis Brand House outlets, which bring Jeep and Citroën sales and service operations together.
Stellantis India's response to Pandey's departure and details of his successor are awaited.
